pulls.title: 8389454: JFR OldObjectSample crashes or reports invalid indices for flat value arrays
pulls.author: mgronlun
pulls.body_excerpt: Greetings, When writing an old-object path to a GC root, `ObjectSampleWriter` calculates the index of a reference within a flat value-array element as though it occupied an ordinary reference-array slot. Using `heapOopSize` instead of the flat element’s stride can therefore produce an invalid index and trigger an assertion in debug builds. This change uses the flat array’s element layout description to determine the correct array index, and resolves the reference’s position within the element into its logical field path. Field-path resolution also handles nested flattened fields within objects

pulls.author: dwhite-intel
pulls.body_excerpt: Intrinsics, stubs, GC barriers, etc may use LEA instructions to capture an x86 address computation into a register. In some cases or configurations the address calculation may not have an index or displacement, but simply a base address register - "LEA rDST, (rSrc)". And MOV instructions may have better latency and throughput than LEA (for example by "executing" in the ROB rather than an actual ALU). pulls.body_excerpt: Before this fix, during the AOT training run, there's an `O(N * M)` number of calls to `os::same_files()` when `N` classes are loaded from a classpath of `M` items. Usually, there will be no calls, except when Windows UNC file names (e.g., `\\?\C:\path\to\file`) are used in the classpath. pulls.author: jatin-bhateja
pulls.activity: 已关闭、2 个 Review、4 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi All, x86 AVX-512 targets provides packed shifts for 16, 32, and 64-bit lanes, but not for bytes. C2 lowers LShiftVB, RShiftVB, and URShiftVB by widening bytes to words, shifting, masking, and packing. That sequence is the byte-shift bottleneck. GFNI **gf2p8affineqb** instruction applies one 8×8 bit matrix to every byte. Logical left, logical right, and arithmetic right shifts by 0..7 are fixed matrices derived from the identity 0x0102040810204080.
